question: Alivardi Khan was a Nawab of ____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bengal**__.

__
 
• **Alivardi Khan** was a **Nawab** of ** Bengal.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alivardi Khan** was the **Nawab of Bengal** from **1740** to **1756.**

 
 
• He toppled the **Nasiri dynasty** of **Nawabs** and assumed power** himself**.
 
• He is also known for his victory during the **Battle of Burdwan** against the **Maratha Empire** during the** Maratha invasions **of **Bengal.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Malabar District, also known as Malayalam District, was an administrative district on the southwestern Malabar Coast of Bombay Presidency and Madras Presidency in British India, and independent India's Madras State.
 
 
 
 

 **Awadh**
 
 
 
• Awadh, known in British historical texts as Avadh or Oudh, is a region and proposed state in the modern Indian state of Uttar Pradesh, which was before independence known as the United Provinces of Agra and Oudh.
 
• In 1858, the state of Awadh was annexed by the British on the charges of mismanagement of the state.
